sources.snippet: Overview llama-2-7b-chat is Meta's Llama 2 7-billion parameter conversational language model, quantized to 4-bit using GPTQ for reduced memory footprint and faster inference. Built and maintained by lucataco, this model runs on Replicate as a containerized Cog implementation of TheBloke's GPTQ-quantized weights.
